chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you both deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the dual pronoun 'kumā' is often interpreted as addressing both the Jinn and humans, or alternatively the angels and humans, highlighting the universal scope of divine favor. This refrain serves not merely as a rhetorical challenge but as a reminder of the covenant of Alast, urging believers to recognize and reciprocate Allah's blessings through gratitude and obedience.
